title: Strict Ramsey recurrence for even summands
statement:
For natural numbers $k, l \ge 2$, let $r(k, l)$ denote the Ramsey number: the least $n$ such that every simple graph on $n$ vertices contains either a clique on $k$ vertices or an independent set on $l$ vertices. If both $r(k, l-1)$ and $r(k-1, l)$ are even, then
\[
r(k, l) < r(k, l-1) + r(k-1, l).
\]
replaced:
